messages:
maria: Deploybot alerted: canary 2.4.1 p95 latency +12% vs baseline, signal labeled 'ambiguous-surge'. Change window ends in ~8m. Deploybot suggests hold but auto-revert threshold not crossed. Thoughts? Release notes still in draft — need decision: auto vs manual rollback, and comms.

deploybot: deploybot: anomaly detected. Auto-revert suppressed due to metric variance. Suggested action: human-review. Runbook excerpt: `/runbook check-latency`. If confirmed >15% for 5m -> revert.

lee: Oncall checking traces now. grabbing logs.

sam: I see an increase in kvcache miss rate on the canary hosts — could be rollout config. Not seeing error rate bump.

maria: Good, so customer-facing errors not up. Prefer to hold for 10m and run quick experiment: pin new sessions to stable 2.4.0. Can someone set a traffic slice?

nina: I can carve a 10% traffic slice to stable. Command I'll run: `/slices create stable-2.4.0 10%`. Assigning to me.

ops-runner: Pushing slice now: `rbac: traffic-slice stable-2.4.0 -> 10%` — done. Monitoring p95.

lee: Traces: span tail shows increased dispatch latency on a single GPU host. Spinning up another canary instance to verify.

deploybot: deploybot: canary-instance-add event: id=5f3a9 — new instance joined; autoscaler triggered.

sam: If latency stays high, my vote is manual rollback to 2.4.0. But let's wait 6m for stats after slice.

maria: :thumbsup: agree. Who will update release notes & comms? We should message customers if we roll back.

nina: I'll update the release notes draft with a note about 'partial traffic rollback' and include rollback rationale. Drafting customer copy now.

lee: p95 returned closer to baseline after slice, delta now +3%. Seems tied to that host. We can hold. Recommend no auto-revert.

maria: Decision: no auto-revert. Manual rollback authority: ops + eng-oncall if p95 >15% sustained for 5m or error rate >0.5% increase. I'll update the release thread and tag legal/CS.

deploybot: deploybot: auto-revert remains suppressed. Notifying ops channel for follow-up. `reason=human_hold`

sam: I'll take owner for next 30m. Setting a reminder. `/remind me check in 30m`

maria: Comms plan: if we manual rollback, Nina will publish release note update, Sam will notify key customers + partner list, Lee will open a post-deploy investigation ticket. Ops-runner will execute rollback steps and confirm service health.

nina: ack. Drafting customer note: short, factual, apologize for instability, link to status page, ETA for follow-up.

ops-runner: If we need rollback command: `./deploy rollback --service=canary --version=2.4.0 --force` — I'll prep runbook snippet in ops-runbook channel.

sam: Thanks. Ping me if the runbook needs input. I'll be on mobile.

maria: :white_check_mark: Closing loop for now. Re-open if metric crosses thresholds. Thanks all.
